successCriteria.description: PgBalanceRepository implements all 6 methods of IBalanceRepository (findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, findByEmployeeIdAndFiscalYear, create, update, deductDays) and each method uses parameterized queries against the pg Pool imported from src/shared/db/connection

PgBalanceRepository.deductDays atomically decrements remaining_days by the given days, increments used_days by the same amount, and sets status to 'exhausted' when remaining_days reaches 0 — all in a single UPDATE RETURNING * statement

BalanceService implements all 3 methods of IBalanceService: getBalance delegates to repository.findByEmployeeIdAndLeaveType, hasSufficientBalance returns true iff remainingDays >= requestedDays (false if balance not found), deductBalance delegates to repository.deductDays

Balance controller exposes two route handlers that call BalanceService: one returns a single balance for an employeeId+leaveType pair, the other returns all balances for an employeeId. Both handlers return 404 when no balance is found and 500 on unexpected errors
Balance routes register as a Fastify plugin function that wires the balance controller's handlers to the appropriate paths, following the same plugin pattern as src/modules/uptime/uptime.routes.ts

PgAuditLogRepository implements all 3 methods of IAuditLogRepository (findByEntity, create, findAll) using parameterized queries against the pg Pool. findAll supports optional filters (entityType, performedBy, fromDate, toDate) that are conditionally appended to the WHERE clause

All 3 unit test files exist and pass: balance.repository.spec.ts (mocks pg Pool, tests all 6 repository methods including deductDays exhaustion logic), balance.service.spec.ts (mocks IBalanceRepository, tests all 3 service methods including edge cases), audit-log.repository.spec.ts (mocks pg Pool, tests all 3 repository methods including filtered findAll)

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer — the BalanceService and BalanceController must never call pool.query directly; they delegate to IBalanceRepository
